words.gloss_range: habitual preventer or withholder, locally specified as active obstruction of good or benefit
words.root_gloss_range: preventing, withholding, blocking, and protective inaccessibility; the local complement selects denial of access to benefit while the barrier image remains useful
words.prose: {{ar:مَنَّاعٍ}} ({{tr:mannāʿin}}) opens this ayah as a continuing genitive epithet, not a new finite report: the same unnamed figure is being identified by a standing trait. Its {{tr:faʿʿāl}} form makes the prevention habitual, and the shaddah-driven pressure in the word makes the blocking feel compressed rather than casual. The following governed phrase makes the habit concrete: he is a repeat blocker with respect to good, not merely someone who once failed to give. The root's barrier and inaccessibility field sharpens the image, while the local phrase keeps the selected sense on denial of benefit rather than protective shielding. The word also carries the prior ayah's intensive-agent rhythm forward (68:11) and flips the scene from harmful circulation to beneficial blockage; the portrait now shows a person who moves harm around and then stands in the way of good. The recurring prevent-good field, with close parallels at 50:25 and 70:21 and a withholding-good moral arc at 3:180, makes the opening charge feel formulaic rather than incidental.

topics.headline: continuing anonymous epithet
topics.summary: The word is a genitive indefinite descriptor in the continuing portrait, not a new clause or named subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a new ayah boundary has not reset the syntax; the same unnamed type is still being built through stacked epithets.
topics.reason: QAC marks an intensive adjective in genitive indefiniteness, and the attachment evidence says the epithets continue the same prior prohibition window.

topics.headline: habitual blocking character
topics.summary: The intensive pattern and marked form class make obstruction a repeated character trait rather than a single act.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees withholding as the person's settled mode of action, with the sound and form tightening around the idea of constriction.
topics.reason: The local form is the intensive adjective, and the distributional evidence treats that form class as small enough to be characterizing.

topics.headline: first charge gets an object
topics.summary: The opening epithet alone takes the governed good-benefit complement, making the first charge concrete before the shorter labels.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the indictment first names a concrete blocked domain before moving to broader moral labels.
topics.reason: The attachment table makes {{ar:لِلْخَيْرِ}} ({{tr:li-l-khayri}}) the syntactically forced complement of {{ar:مَنَّاعٍ}} ({{tr:mannāʿin}}).

topics.headline: barrier image, not protective sense
topics.summary: The root's fortification and inaccessibility side supplies a barrier image, while the local complement selects denial of access to benefit.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures the fault as making good unreachable, while avoiding the mistaken idea that protective shielding is the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The broader root family supports blocking and protective inaccessibility, but the governed good-benefit complement narrows the local reading to obstructive withholding.

topics.headline: recurring prevent-good field
topics.summary: The local phrase participates in a known prevent-good configuration and a wider withholding-good moral arc.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes {{ar:مَنَّاعٍ لِلْخَيْرِ}} ({{tr:mannāʿin li-l-khayri}}) as part of a recurring Quranic pattern of blocking benefit (50:25; 70:21) and morally charged withholding (3:180).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete co-occurrence and inter-ayah references, and the local syntax exactly joins prevention with good-benefit.

topics.headline: boundary flips movement to blockage
topics.summary: The word carries the prior intensive-agent cadence into the new ayah while changing the image from harmful movement to obstructed good.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears continuity with 68:11 while seeing the moral scene pivot from circulating harm to blocking benefit.
topics.reason: The same intensive pattern and genitive tanwīn link the neighboring epithets, while the boundary rows explicitly mark the semantic pivot from motion to obstruction.

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is small, but it does the binding work in the first charge. It fastens {{ar:ٱلْخَيْرِ}} ({{tr:al-khayri}}) to {{ar:مَنَّاعٍ}} ({{tr:mannāʿin}}), so good is not a loose topic, possession, or beneficiary; it is the domain toward which the obstruction is directed. Because the particle fuses in recitation as {{ar:لِلْخَيْرِ}} ({{tr:li-l-khayri}}), the sound also makes the dependency audible: the opening epithet cannot be heard as complete until the governed object arrives. This dependency forms one longer first beat before the ayah turns to the two shorter asyndetic epithets.

topics.headline: object-domain marker
topics.summary: The lām marks good as the specified matter or object-domain of prevention.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the fault is directed at good itself, not at an unnamed beneficiary or an owned item.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the prepositional complement relation and warns against treating the phrase as a beneficiary expression.

topics.headline: fused particle-noun unit
topics.summary: The proclitic lām fuses with the definite noun, making the governed object one pronounced unit.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the grammar in the recited shape: the particle and the blocked good arrive as one bound unit.
topics.reason: The surface form and pronunciation of {{ar:لِلْخَيْرِ}} ({{tr:li-l-khayri}}) support the CRITICAL claim that the function word is not free-standing in effect.

topics.headline: one longer first charge
topics.summary: The lām creates dependency rather than coordination, so the first two words form one charge before the later epithets.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why the ayah first slows into a specified obstruction before snapping into shorter labels.
topics.reason: There is no conjunction between the epithet and its complement; the local relation is dependency through lām.

words.gloss_range: the good, benefit, advantage, and materially useful good as the governed domain of prevention
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, benefit, wealth or property, preference, and what is better; locally gathered as the definite abstract object-domain of obstruction
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْخَيْرِ}} ({{tr:al-khayri}}) is the thing made inaccessible by the preventer. The article and singular abstract form do not narrow the object to one favor; they gather the recognized field of good, benefit, wealth, advantage, and preferable outcome into one blocked domain. The local lām assigns it genitive case and makes it the semantic object of prevention, so the charge is not vague miserliness but obstruction of what should count as good for others. The same noun can carry material force in 2:180 and 100:8, so the economic dimension remains available beside the moral one. Its tight pairing with prevention and later same-surah returns at 68:32 and 68:38 keep good from being a throwaway object; it becomes a lexical thread in the surah. The moon-letter onset also keeps the governed noun perceptible after the article and lām, so the blocked object lands audibly rather than disappearing into the prefix.

topics.headline: blocked domain of good
topics.summary: The noun is governed through lām and functions semantically as the object-domain denied by the preventer.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that good is the affected domain of the obstruction, not a free-standing theme.
topics.reason: The attachment profile explicitly assigns {{ar:ٱلْخَيْرِ}} ({{tr:al-khayri}}) as the complement of {{ar:مَنَّاعٍ}} ({{tr:mannāʿin}}) through lām.

topics.headline: the category of benefit
topics.summary: Definiteness and singular abstract shape gather good as a recognized mass category rather than enumerated items.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the blocked object as the field of benefit as such, not merely one instance of generosity.
topics.reason: The local noun is definite, singular, and abstract; the CRITICAL rows coherently treat those features as widening the object.

topics.headline: wide good-benefit range
topics.summary: The word carries moral, material, and preferential senses, while the local syntax keeps them gathered as the object of obstruction rather than as an explicit comparison.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the blocked good can include moral benefit and material advantage, but the ayah is not making an overt comparative statement.
topics.reason: V4 and CRITICAL evidence support the broad semantic range, while the local definite noun after lām selects the benefit-domain rather than a comparative construction.

topics.headline: economic charge remains available
topics.summary: Occurrences where the same noun denotes wealth keep the material dimension available in the local obstruction charge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the indictment as capable of covering hoarded material benefit as well as blocked moral good (2:180; 100:8).
topics.reason: The concrete references preserve a Quranic usage of {{ar:ٱلْخَيْرِ}} ({{tr:al-khayri}}) as wealth, and nothing in the local syntax excludes that dimension.

topics.headline: local pair and surah thread
topics.summary: The word joins a prevention-good co-occurrence field and also returns later in the same surah.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that good is both the local partner of prevention and a lexical thread that resurfaces later in the surah (68:32; 68:38).
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows and same-surah echo rows give concrete provenance for retaining the lexical-thread payoff.

topics.headline: audible noun onset
topics.summary: The moon-letter onset keeps the governed noun perceptible after the article and lām.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the blocked object land clearly after the binding particle.
topics.reason: The surface pronunciation supports the CRITICAL observation that the onset remains audible rather than assimilating away.

words.gloss_range: one who transgresses or oversteps, locally an active-participle epithet of hostile boundary violation
words.root_gloss_range: running, passing beyond, crossing a limit, hostility, aggression, and transgression; locally selected as moral overstepping with motion imagery retained
words.prose: {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:muʿtadin}}) shifts from the specified obstruction of good to a compact person-label: an overstepper. As a Form VIII active participle, it does not narrate one past act or name one object crossed; it presents boundary violation as the figure's ongoing stance within the same genitive epithet chain. The root's motion sense still matters: running or passing beyond becomes moral crossing, and the hostile-aggression branch keeps the overstepping from sounding merely technical. The local form narrows the range, however, to the agent who himself oversteps rather than a causative mover of someone else. Its position without conjunction makes it the middle blow of the list, bridging blocked good and the final guilt-state; the matching final -in cadence makes the last two single-word charges strike as an audible pair. Prohibition parallels at 2:190 and 5:87 show that the epithet names as a person what other passages forbid as an act.

topics.headline: ongoing overstepper label
topics.summary: The active participle functions as a standing nominal epithet in the same genitive chain.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees transgression as a defining label, not as a narrated episode.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form VIII active participle in indefinite genitive agreement, supporting the CRITICAL reading of a standing epithet.

topics.headline: unbounded middle charge
topics.summary: The word remains syntactically dependent on the larger portrait and has no complement naming a specific boundary.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the middle charge is generalized: no single crossed limit exhausts the accusation.
topics.reason: The word agrees with the other indefinite genitive epithets and receives no local complement, unlike the first charge.

topics.headline: crossing image becomes aggression
topics.summary: The root's running and passing-beyond image survives inside the selected moral-hostile transgression sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears transgression as crossing a line, while the local sequence after blocking good keeps it from becoming neutral motion.
topics.reason: The root range includes motion and hostility, but the local active participle in this moral descriptor sequence selects overstepping aggression.

topics.headline: self-involved overstepping
topics.summary: Form VIII makes the agent himself the overstepper rather than a causative mover of another.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form places the excess on the agent's own stance and action.
topics.reason: QAC gives a Form VIII active participle, and the CRITICAL rows contrast it with causative crossing forms.

topics.headline: forbidden act personified
topics.summary: The epithet belongs to a larger prohibition and transgressor-sinner field.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word name as a person what divine prohibitions reject as conduct (2:190; 5:87), and then pair it locally with guilt-state language.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL evidence provides concrete prohibition parallels and a local adjacency with {{ar:أَثِيمٍ}} ({{tr:athīmin}}), including the recurring pairing at 83:12.

topics.headline: compact middle blow
topics.summary: The asyndetic one-word epithet bridges the opening obstruction and final guilt label, sharing cadence with the final word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the middle word land separately and then lock audibly to the final epithet.
topics.reason: No conjunction precedes the word, and the final tanwīn cadence matches the following epithet.

words.gloss_range: deeply sinful, culpable, guilt-bearing, locally the final qualitative epithet sealing the portrait
words.root_gloss_range: sin, guilt, crime, moral burden, punishable liability, and an older slowness or lagging image; locally selected as settled culpability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preceding active participle epithet of overstepping

words.prose: {{ar:أَثِيمٍ}} ({{tr:athīmin}}) closes the ayah by converting the visible charges into an inner moral diagnosis. It remains in the same genitive-indefinite chain, so the final word still belongs to the anonymous portrait, but its {{tr:faʿīl}} quality makes sinfulness sound settled rather than episodic. That form also keeps the guilt intrinsic: it is neither an accuser's assignment from outside nor an avoidance posture. The root field adds weight: guilt is not only wrongdoing but culpable burden and punishable liability, with a background image of falling behind the right moral course. The final position matters because the ayah has moved from blocking good, to overstepping limits, to this compact state-label. Its local pairing with {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:muʿtadin}}) joins boundary violation to guilt, and the broader condemned-epithet set at 26:222, 44:44, 45:7, and 83:12 shows that this is a recognized seal of moral condemnation.

topics.headline: same chain, final seal
topics.summary: The final adjective agrees with the preceding genitive-indefinite epithets and closes the same descriptor chain.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verdict still belongs to the same unnamed portrait rather than starting a new statement.
topics.reason: QAC marks the final word as an indefinite genitive qualitative adjective, and the attachment profile keeps the epithets within the same discourse-inferred portrait.

topics.headline: settled guilt quality
topics.summary: The faʿīl adjective presents sinfulness as an entrenched quality rather than a single act or external accusation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the last word as a character diagnosis: the prior acts amount to settled culpability.
topics.reason: The qualitative adjective form and smaller occurrence class support a person-quality label rather than a verbal report of sinning.

topics.headline: burdened guilt with lag image
topics.summary: The root field supplies guilt, crime, burden, liability, and a slowness image, while the local word selects culpable sinfulness.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final label as weighty liability, with sin pictured as falling behind the right course, not just a vague bad trait.
topics.reason: The semantic evidence supports burden and lag imagery, but the local qualitative adjective keeps the selected sense on culpable sinfulness.

topics.headline: not accusation or avoidance
topics.summary: Related forms for accusation or avoiding sin illuminate the field, but the local surface names the opposite: intrinsic guilt.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is not an accuser's label from outside or an avoidance posture; it names guilt as the figure's own quality.
topics.reason: The local form is the faʿīl adjective, so related derivations are useful contrast but cannot replace the selected quality reading.

topics.headline: condemned epithet field
topics.summary: The word belongs to a recurrent condemned-figure epithet set and completes the local transgressor-sinner pair.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the closing label as part of a wider condemned-figure vocabulary (26:222; 44:44; 45:7; 83:12) and as the guilt counterpart to local overstepping.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply both broader occurrence references and local co-occurrence with {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:muʿtadin}}).

topics.headline: climactic inner verdict
topics.summary: The final short beat compresses the sequence from public act to boundary violation to inner culpability.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the list accelerate into a final inner verdict, with no conjunction interrupting the movement from act to state.
topics.reason: The word is final in the ayah, shares cadence with the prior epithet, and the CRITICAL rows consistently treat the three labels as an escalating diagnostic sequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ links intensive prevention, good, boundary crossing, and lag from good.
baseline_models.mechanism: The four terms form a one-way social valve: the subject closes the route by which benefit would reach others, yet crosses limits in the opposite direction; the resulting moral motion is not neutral stillness but persistent delay from good.

activation_trace.role: A barrier placed between a person and what is sought supplies the valve's closed outward route.
Desired and beneficial good identifies what the barrier prevents from circulating.
Unjust crossing beyond a limit supplies the opposite-direction movement through boundaries.
Slowness and lag behind good turn the closed valve into a temporal moral condition.

changed_reading.before: A list of four bad traits: stingy, aggressive, sinful.
changed_reading.after: A single asymmetric mechanism: benefit is stopped from going out while violation moves outward, leaving the actor chronically behind the good he blocks.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction لِّلْخَيْرِ can hold the choice-seeking branch of خ ي ر inside the barrier-and-crossing sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject may obstruct not only a gift but another person's access to the better option. Boundary crossing then becomes diversion of the decision toward some other course, while liability is shifted onto the person whose choice was constrained.

activation_trace.role: The intervening barrier supplies control over another person's route to an intended object or act.
Seeking or selecting the better alternative makes choice itself the good being obstructed.
Passing beyond and diverting from a matter supplies the redirection of a constrained choice.
Loading or charging sin onto someone supplies the possibility that the gatekeeper externalizes the cost of his diversion.

changed_reading.before: He refuses to distribute charitable goods.
changed_reading.after: He captures access to the better course, redirects other people's decisions, and can leave them carrying the cost.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The protective-strength branch of م ن ع and the edge branch of ع د و make the phrase spatial without detaching it from withheld خير.
baseline_models.mechanism: Good is treated as an enclosed reserve: protective strength makes it inaccessible, a perimeter distinguishes inside from outside, and the subject claims freedom to cross the very edge that excludes others.

activation_trace.role: Inaccessible protective strength supplies the enclosure around the retained benefit.
Gift and beneficence identify the reserve enclosed behind that protection.
A side, bank, or edge supplies a concrete perimeter whose access is unequal.

changed_reading.before: Withholding is a momentary refusal to hand something over.
changed_reading.after: Withholding is an architecture of fortified access: good is made unreachable to outsiders while its controller moves across the boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The intensive form مَّنَّاع and the packet's non-dominant ع د و to ع و د mapping allow repeated practice to remain a focus-only possibility.
baseline_models.mechanism: Obstruction and transgression may be a trained loop rather than isolated acts. Repetition turns crossing into disposition, while each cycle again delays the subject from good.

activation_trace.role: Recurring contention over a thing supplies repeated resistance rather than a single refusal.
The non-dominant mapped image of habit, drill, and persistence supplies practiced recurrence to the crossing.
Repeated lag from good supplies the accumulating temporal result of the habit.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns an occasional refusal followed by an occasional violation.
changed_reading.after: It can diagnose a rehearsed cycle in which resistance and overstepping have become a durable habit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's arc from pen and written line, through the dismissal of signs as false stories and the demand for an authorizing book, to remembrance as a document of right activates an epistemic form of منع الخير: control the admissible record and one controls access to the better judgment.

activation_trace.role: The focus barrier anchors the proposed gate over knowledge and judgment.
Choosing the better option anchors why access to a trustworthy record counts as خير.
The sharpened writing instrument supplies the production channel for an inspectable record.
The false-story image supplies the hostile relabeling by which a real record is denied admission.
A written establishment that obligates judgment supplies the missing warrant challenged by the questions.
Remembrance as a deed or document of right supplies the closing counter-record that resists the gate.

structural_cues: The surah opens with writing, later asks whether the claimants possess a book, and closes by naming the message a remembrance for all worlds.
68:15 attempts to demote recited signs into stories of predecessors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, false-story, binding-record, and right-document images; I infer that restricting what counts as an admissible record is one way to block access to خير; the live alternative is that these are separate truth claims with no gatekeeping mechanism.

changed_reading.before: مناع للخير concerns only material generosity.
changed_reading.after: It can also name epistemic gatekeeping: barring the record by which people could recognize and choose the better course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier reward described through non-cutting and non-burdening exposes the focus character as its inverse. Healthy benefit continues without being weaponized against its recipient; the intensive withholder either interrupts that continuity or converts beneficence into leverage.

activation_trace.role: Holding back the giving hand supplies the focus-side interruption of beneficence.
Gift and generosity identify the benefit whose manner of delivery is contrasted.
Cutting or diminishing an extension supplies the interruption explicitly negated for the reward.
Burdening a beneficiary by rehearsing one's favor supplies the coercive-gift alternative also excluded there.

structural_cues: 68:3 places an unbroken, non-reproachful reward before 68:12's intensive blocker of gift.
The near sound-pattern of مَمْنُون and مَنَّاع sharpens the contrast without making them the same root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two distinct م ن ن images, cutting continuity and burdening a recipient, beside focus withholding and gift; I infer a contrast between uncoercive giving and corrupted giving; the live alternative is that 68:3 only states endless reward and does not specify social gift ethics.

changed_reading.before: The fault is simply not giving.
changed_reading.after: The fault includes corrupting the whole path of giving, either by cutting benefit off or by making the recipient pay through dependence and reproach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The character profile becomes a selective membrane. It is soft and permeable to strategic accommodation and lets injurious speech walk outward, while the route for beneficial good is closed; the focus branch of transmitted disease makes the asymmetry causal rather than merely topical.

activation_trace.role: The barrier supplies selective closure against beneficial passage.
An affliction passing from one bearer to another supplies the transmission model for social injury.
Soft accommodation and ingratiation supply permeability where compromise serves the harmful network.
Walking with tale-bearing gives harmful speech a mobile carrier.
Speech escaping as betrayal supplies the damaging content released through the membrane.

structural_cues: 68:9 imagines reciprocal accommodation, 68:11 depicts mobile tale-bearing, and 68:12 immediately names intensive obstruction of good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies soft accommodation, walking gossip, escaping speech, and disease transfer; I infer one selective-permeability mechanism in which harm travels but good does not; the live alternative is a simple accumulation of unrelated vices.

changed_reading.before: The subject is indiscriminately hard and antisocial.
changed_reading.after: He is selectively open: harmful alliances and reports pass efficiently through him, while beneficial flow is deliberately stopped.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence stages the focus mechanism and reverses its direction. The owners intend to cut the crop while contracting access against a person needing sustaining provision; the crop is cut off, and those who meant to deprive another recognize themselves as deprived and as holders-back of a right.

activation_trace.role: Withholding the giving hand anchors the owners' intended exclusion from harvest.
Gift and beneficence identify the share meant to move from crop-holder to needy entrant.
Cutting and separation supply both the planned harvest action and the eventual severance of access.
Provision that stabilizes a person's dwelling makes the excluded miskin a concrete endpoint for sustaining good.
Prevention and contraction supply the owners' coordinated closure of access.
Deprivation and loss of the sought thing name the state that rebounds onto the planners.
Holding or confining someone from a right identifies the acknowledged moral structure of the plan.

structural_cues: The owners leave early so that no needy person will enter, then say that they themselves are deprived.
The repeated ص ر م vocabulary joins their intended cutting to the garden's cut-off state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies planned exclusion, severance, sustaining provision, contraction, deprivation, and withholding from a right; I infer a rebound in which the barrier changes sides; the live alternative is that the narrative exemplifies the vice without asserting a general reversal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: مناع للخير is a static character label.
changed_reading.after: It is an executable social pattern whose attempted one-way deprivation can reverse, making the gatekeepers inhabit the deprivation they designed for someone else.

context_deltas.mechanism: أثيم becomes a disorder of moral timing. A just or best-positioned voice was available, but collective action outran it; acknowledgment of withholding from a right and mutual reconsideration arrive only after the loss.

activation_trace.role: Lagging behind good anchors sin as delayed alignment rather than an unstructured moral label.
Justice and chosen excellence at the middle supply the already-available corrective voice.
Confining another from a right supplies the content recognized too late.
Tarrying and pausing before action activates the missing interval for deliberation, now displaced into after-the-fact blame.

structural_cues: 68:28 reports prior counsel, while 68:29-31 place confession and blame after the garden is gone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an available just voice, recognition of a withheld right, and a branch of deliberative delay; I infer that أثيم names action moving faster than conscience and conscience arriving after damage; the live alternative is that the sequence only records repentance after punishment.

changed_reading.after: أثيم diagnoses moral latency: knowing or being told the good does not become timely action, so recognition trails the harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The questions about judgment, a binding book, unrestricted choice, and a guarantor activate the baseline choice-capture model at an institutional scale. The blocker claims the output of a procedure while withholding the warrant and crossing the boundary between preference and enforceable right.

activation_trace.role: The barrier anchors exclusion from a shared route to judgment.
Seeking a governor or judge for redress supplies the public procedure displaced by private assertion.
Judgment between people supplies the procedural domain in which access is being claimed.
A record that establishes an obligation supplies the absent public warrant.
Selecting the preferred option makes the context's promised entitlement a direct activation of focus خير.
Bearing a guarantee supplies the accountability demanded for the asserted outcome.

structural_cues: 68:35-41 repeatedly asks what rule, book, oath, guarantor, or partner could authorize the preferred outcome.
The branchless ك ي ف at 68:36 functions only as the structural interrogation of their manner of judging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, binding record, preferred selection, guarantee, and a sequence of authorization questions; I infer that blocking خير can operate as capture of procedure; the live alternative is that the questions refute a belief without extending 68:12 beyond interpersonal withholding.

changed_reading.before: The withholder privately keeps a benefit for himself.
changed_reading.after: The withholder can capture a shared decision process, reserve the preferred outcome, and suppress the warrant by which others could contest it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The outward barrier can harden into inward incapacity. Earlier ability and invitation give way to inability to perform submission; moral delay reaches a deadline, and the agent who repeatedly obstructed good can no longer make his own body cross toward it.

activation_trace.role: The focus barrier anchors the obstruction that is now read as turning back upon the agent.
Lagging from good supplies the temporal path from available response to missed capacity.
Ability and capacity identify precisely what is absent at the later summons.
Lowering oneself in submission supplies the good-directed movement the body cannot complete.
Time pressure, haste, and delay supply a closing temporal window around the failed movement.
Making a difficult thing tractable supplies the ease that prior soundness offered but later humiliation does not.

structural_cues: 68:42 says they cannot respond, while 68:43 says they had previously been called while sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior soundness, later incapacity, submission, and temporal pressure; I infer habituation or judgment as the arrow by which an outward barrier becomes self-obstruction; the live alternative is juxtaposition of past refusal and later consequence without a psychological hardening process.

changed_reading.before: Blocking good only harms the excluded recipient.
changed_reading.after: Repeatedly building the barrier may deform the blocker too, until his own route toward responsive submission is closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fortified-enclosure baseline is destabilized by the context's temporal mechanics. Apparent protection and delayed consequence need not mean the withholder is unreachable; extension can be a staged taking, and firmness can belong to the enclosing counter-process rather than to his private reserve.

activation_trace.role: Protective strength that seems inaccessible anchors the apparent fortress now being revised.
Delay from good makes prolonged time morally ambiguous rather than evidence of security.
Taking degree after degree supplies a controlled process hidden inside apparent continuity.
Extension and respite in time supply the interval easily misread as immunity.
Deliberate delay in a race supplies firmness expressed through timing rather than immediate impact.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 explicitly joins gradual taking, unperceived direction, temporal extension, and a firm counter-plan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inaccessible-strength image, graded taking, respite, and firm delay; I infer that the withholder mistakes elapsed time for a defensive wall; the live alternative is that these verses describe external punishment without commenting on his self-conception.

changed_reading.before: The withholder's protected resources and delayed consequences prove that his enclosure works.
changed_reading.after: His apparent fortress may be only borrowed time inside a firmer staged process; delay does not certify immunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command and rescue distinguish restraint by its object and direction. Blocking benefit from another is condemned, but holding one's own panic, anger, or speech can keep the channel open until favor catches up; restraint turns from vice to virtue when the self, rather than خير, is what is held back.

activation_trace.role: Holding back the giving hand anchors the condemned outward direction of restraint.
Refusal of indecency supplies a positive counter-image showing that prevention itself is not uniformly vicious.
Gift and beneficence identify what must remain unblocked in the condemned configuration.
Holding the self back from panic supplies disciplined inward restraint.
Containing anger in the interior supplies the dangerous pressure that patience must govern.
Catching up and reaching supplies the preserved arrival of rescue through the open channel.
Favor and good condition identify what reaches the restrained agent rather than being blocked by him.

structural_cues: 68:48 commands patience and recalls the companion of the fish while he was full of constrained pressure.
68:49-50 makes favor catch him, then selection and repair follow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward withholding, chaste refusal, self-restraint, contained anger, catching up, and favor; I infer that the moral variable is what is restrained and toward whom; the live alternative is that the positive م ن ع branch is only a lexical counter-image and does not interpret the focus adjective.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns hardness or restraint as such.
changed_reading.after: It condemns restraining خير from others; the same architecture reverses morally when one restrains the reactive self so that favor and repair can still arrive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene turns obstruction into an attempted anti-transmission campaign. Cover the truth, dislodge its bearer when hearing it, and refuse understanding; yet the final description gives the remembrance world-wide scope, so the local gate over good fails to contain its circulation.

activation_trace.role: The barrier anchors the attempt to stop beneficial transmission by controlling its carrier.
Beneficial good anchors why the transmitted remembrance belongs to the focus mechanism.
Covering the truth supplies concealment as the first transmission barrier.
Making something slip from its station supplies the attempt to remove or destabilize the carrier.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies the reception the opponents resist.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the content whose scope outruns the attempted gate.

structural_cues: 68:51 links hearing the remembrance to an attempt to make its bearer slip, and 68:52 immediately expands that remembrance to all worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth-covering, dislodgement, receptive hearing, reminder, and universal scope; I infer a campaign to stop transmission by destabilizing its bearer; the live alternative is a direct hostile reaction with no generalized circulation model.

changed_reading.before: The focus subject blocks discrete acts of generosity.
changed_reading.after: He participates in blocking the carrier and reception of a good that is meant to circulate beyond his local control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the remote خير image of drawing an animal from its burrow and joins it to a later slipping-from-place image. It remains anchored in focus خير and the focus barrier, with 68:51 supplying a visible dislodgement analogue. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory coercive-space model, not as a claim that خير literally means a trap here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَنَّاعٍ and خَيْرِ can be tested as control of the route between shelter and exposed access.

activation_trace.role: A barrier between seeker and sought supplies the ability to redesign another's available route.
Drawing an animal from its burrow supplies the strange image of manipulated exit from refuge.
Dislodging something from its station supplies the exposed endpoint of the manipulated route.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can be coercive spatial design: block the safe route, induce emergence, and dislodge the target from a stable position.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ع د و to ع د د mapping rather than the ordinary transgression root. It remains focus-anchored through مُعْتَدٍ and is materially sharpened by the garden's division, cutting, and purposeful prevention. Downstream prose should label it a split-root logistical analogy, never a morphological replacement for مُعْتَدٍ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet permits the non-dominant prepared-provision branch under focus مُعْتَدٍ as an exploratory account of how intensive withholding is organized.

activation_trace.role: Holding back the giving hand anchors the distributive act being organized.
The non-dominant image of preparing stores, equipment, or provision supplies planned logistical capacity.
Dividing a thing into allotted shares supplies the distributive calculation behind the plan.
Harvest cutting supplies the operation around which access and shares are scheduled.
Purposeful intention supplies coordination rather than spontaneous aggression.

changed_reading.before: Transgression is an impulsive outburst accompanying stinginess.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the transgression is logistical: inventory, timing, division, and prepared capacity are arranged so that withholding succeeds.

strongest_changes: The focus epithets cohere as a one-way valve: good is blocked while violation and harmful speech move outward.
The garden narrative executes and reverses that valve, turning intended deprivation into the planners' own deprivation.
أثيم becomes moral latency: action outruns available counsel, and recognition arrives after harm.
The later patience sequence distinguishes blocking خير from blocking one's own reactive impulse.
Writing, judgment, and remembrance extend withholding from material goods to control over records, choices, and transmission.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah repeatedly behaved less like a pile of insults than a topology of access, timing, and direction. Context activated material, social, procedural, bodily, and epistemic versions without forcing them into one final reading; the split mappings additionally exposed habit and logistics as contained exploratory mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The rebound from withholding to deprivation is strongly staged by the garden sequence, but treating it as a general causal law remains abductive.
The arrow from repeated refusal to later bodily incapacity is reader-supplied; the text can instead juxtapose past choice and consequence.
خير remains productively broad across gift, beneficial good, preferred choice, and access to truth; no single scope should erase the others.
The ع و د and ع د د activations are non-dominant split-root readings and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Withholding generates boundary-crossing.** `م ن ع B001/B002` supplies refusal and barrier, `خ ي ر B001/B005` desired good and beneficent gift, `ع د و B001` overstepping into injustice, and `ء ث م B001` lagging from good. The adjective sequence moves from blocked flow to aggressive excess to settled culpability. I infer obstructed good -> unjust encroachment elsewhere; the ayah becomes a causal profile rather than a loose list.
2. **Private fortress against public benefit.** `م ن ع B003` supplies inaccessible protective strength, while `ع د و B003` supplies enmity. The garden owners later coordinate to bar the poor (68:24) and discover themselves deprived (68:27). I infer protection converted into exclusion creates hostile social space; *mannāʿ* thus reads as fortifying possession against claims of benefit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:24-27 turned this profile into a mechanism: the poor are barred from good, then the barrers discover themselves deprived. 68:32's hope for a better gift shows the correction is not hostility to possession itself but a reorientation of how good is received and distributed.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A checkpoint that blocks good and pushes beyond its proper bound.** Fixed `مَّنَّاع` activates `م ن ع B002` (a barrier between a person and what is sought), while fixed `مُعْتَد` activates `ع د و B001` (overstepping a bound). The path of 68:7 and the obedience/compromise pressure of 68:8-10 supply movement toward and diversion from a course; I infer that withholding functions as an erected barrier whose operator crosses the very boundary he polices. The ayah reads as spatially organized injustice, not a list of dispositions.
2. **Wrongdoing propagated as a delay from good.** Fixed `مُعْتَد` also activates `ع د و B006` (contagion and transmission), and fixed `أَثِيم` activates `ء ث م B001` (lagging behind good). Mobile tale-bearing in 68:11 and the fabricated-old-tales response in 68:15 supply transmission through speech; I infer that circulating obstruction causes both speaker and recipients to fall behind the good being blocked. Sin reads as the transmissible slowing effect of the network.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:15 made the transmission branch of fixed transgression (`ع د و B006`) newly visible: the obstruction of good is reproduced through a circulating interpretive formula. 68:17 then shifted withholding from a personal vice toward a property mechanism about to be tested.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Direction Can Guide Bodies or Circulate Harm
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Movement acquires moral and social force through its route, guide, gait, and carried content.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Tale-bearing becomes a corrupted form of wayfaring: the same moving body that can follow a guide can also transport injury between people.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gait Registers Capacity, Terrain, and Exhaustion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler moves on foot across edges and uneven ground; fatigue, bodily weakness, or reliance on companions alters the gait.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deliberate walking (`quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`); running (`quranic:root_000993:B002/m01`); bank or side of a route (`quranic:root_000993:B009/m01`); hard uneven ground (`quranic:root_000993:B010/m01`); travel on foot (`quranic:root_001525:B012/m01`); supported swaying walk (`quranic:root_001583:B008/m01`); calm, composed gait (`quranic:root_001583:B010/m01`); exhaustion of walker or mount (`quranic:root_001315:B001/m01`); body worn down by use (`quranic:root_001453:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Movement discloses condition. The same route can carry a runner, an exhausted mount, a composed traveler, or a weakened pedestrian, so gait becomes a visible measure of agency rather than a neutral change of place.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Authority is enacted by keeping charge, binding parties, directing motion, or deciding whether restraint continues.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lordship, contract, bridle-like obedience, coercive hauling, and release from captivity occupy one field of controlled attachment without being reduced to one moral value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Obedience, Refusal, and Coercive Hauling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A command seeks smooth compliance; resistance hardens into mutual pushing or refusal, and force then drags the resistant body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: obedient following (`quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`); mutual compliance (`quranic:root_000956:B002/m01`); the self making action easy (`quranic:root_000956:B006/m01`); violent hauling (`quranic:root_000980:B001/m01`); refusal to move or submit (`quranic:root_000980:B005/m01`); servant or enforcer (`quranic:root_000980:B006/m01`); transgressive overstepping (`quranic:root_000993:B001/m01`); obstructing barrier (`quranic:root_001448:B002/m01`); protected force (`quranic:root_001448:B003/m01`); mutual resistance (`quranic:root_001448:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Compliance ranges from willing alignment to reciprocal accommodation. Against it stand barrier, fortified resistance, and the brutal hauling encoded by `عُتُلّ`, giving the prohibition on obedience a concrete politics of who directs whose body.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Provision Builds Households or Is Arrested at the Hand
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material good becomes socially meaningful through giving, nurturing, earning, withholding, and household reproduction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wealth and sons are not static possessions; lexical scenes show provision moving through wages, gifts, marriage, livestock, and care, or failing through blocked hands and depleted stores.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Favor Moves as Reward, Gift, and Nurture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A benefactor gives a useful good, a caretaker grows it over time, and recompense returns value for work without exhausting the source.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: favor and good condition (`quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`); ease and comfortable living (`quranic:root_001525:B002/m01`); delight to the eye (`quranic:root_001525:B013/m01`); favor that can burden its recipient (`quranic:root_001449:B003/m01`); nurturing benefaction (`quranic:root_000532:B016/m01`); desired beneficial good (`quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`); generosity and gift (`quranic:root_000452:B005/m01`); recompense or wage (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`); visible traces of prosperity (`quranic:root_000497:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:2 `نِعْمَةِ` [ن ع م] and `رَبِّ` [ر ب ب]; 68:3 `أَجْرًا` [ء ج ر] and `مَمْنُونٍ` [م ن ن]; 68:9 `تُدْهِنُ` [د ه ن]; 68:12 `خَيْرِ` [خ ي ر].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Favor is a flow joining giver, work, recipient, and visible result. The branch contrast inside `م ن ن` adds a precise risk: a gift can sustain, or its verbal recounting can crush the recipient and undo the social good.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Provision Builds Households or Is Arrested at the Hand
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material good becomes socially meaningful through giving, nurturing, earning, withholding, and household reproduction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wealth and sons are not static possessions; lexical scenes show provision moving through wages, gifts, marriage, livestock, and care, or failing through blocked hands and depleted stores.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Withholding Hand Produces Scarcity and Weakness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hand refuses transfer, a barrier blocks access, and the resulting shortage appears as scant water, little milk, depleted strength, or an emptied belly.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hand withheld from giving (`quranic:root_001448:B001/m01`); barrier to desired access (`quranic:root_001448:B002/m02`); weakness and contempt (`quranic:root_001453:B001/m01`); scant water or sterile issue (`quranic:root_001453:B006/m01`); little milk (`quranic:root_000497:B006/m01`); lost strength (`quranic:root_001449:B002/m01`); camel belly retaining no water (`quranic:root_001557:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Withholding is rendered hydrologically and bodily. What begins as a social refusal at the hand terminates in low milk, low water, weak reproductive force, and an emptied animal, making deprivation a material outcome rather than only a vice.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Assay Exposes Formation and Moral Texture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Pressure reveals whether a formed thing is sound, rough, delayed, brittle, or fit for its intended work.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Character is treated like material under assay: measured before formation, tested by fire or ordeal, and disclosed through hardness, lag, excess, and capacity for repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lag, Roughness, and Overstepping Reveal Defective Material
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A subject lags behind good, crosses a boundary, resists easy handling, and presents a coarse or blunt texture under pressure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: delay from good (`quranic:root_000013:B001/m01`); abstention from wrongdoing (`quranic:root_000013:B002/m01`); penalty of wrongdoing (`quranic:root_000013:B003/m01`); loading another with guilt (`quranic:root_000013:B004/m01`); unjust overstepping (`quranic:root_000993:B001/m02`); twisted difficulty (`quranic:root_000993:B012/m01`); coarse hostile character (`quranic:root_000980:B002/m01`); severe thickness (`quranic:root_000980:B004/m01`); low weak judgment (`quranic:root_001453:B001/m02`); bluntness and exhaustion (`quranic:root_001315:B001/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:10 `كُلَّ` [ك ل ل] and `مَّهِينٍ` [م ه ن]; 68:12 `مُعْتَدٍ` [ع د و] and `أَثِيمٍ` [ء ث م]; 68:13 `عُتُلٍّ` [ع ت ل].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The denunciatory sequence has distinct mechanics. Sin delays movement toward good, transgression crosses the limit, `عُتُلّ` supplies coarse resistant bulk, and `مَهِين` names depleted discernment; these are not interchangeable moral labels.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Assay Exposes Formation and Moral Texture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Pressure reveals whether a formed thing is sound, rough, delayed, brittle, or fit for its intended work.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pride Hardens; Repair Restores Fit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Self-magnification and head-raised anger harden a person against correction, while repair, exchange, and selection restore useful form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: arrogant self-enlargement (`quranic:root_001029:B006/m01`); angry raised-head pride (`quranic:root_000404:B004/m02`); imposing judgment on another (`quranic:root_001272:B010/m01`); nurture and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m02`); material or practical repair (`quranic:root_001119:B001/m01`); transformation or replacement (`quranic:root_001119:B003/m01`); selected excellence (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Pride is a deformation of magnitude into self-hardening. The counter-process is not mere condemnation but correction: tend, repair, exchange the damaged state, and select what is genuinely fit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Rain Materializes Provision in Soil, Plant, and Herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The abstract vocabulary of favor is grounded in an ecology whose failures are equally specific: insufficient rain, dry basins, weak milk, and wandering livestock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covered Garden, Grain Ear, and Aromatic Growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water drives enclosing vegetation upward; grain extends into ears, low plants spread, and aromatic growth announces itself by scent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); dense rising vegetation (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); persistent green plant (`quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`); extended grain ear (`quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`); low salt plant (`quranic:root_001252:B007/m01`); halfa grass (`quranic:root_000349:B005/m01`); aromatic plant disclosed by smell (`quranic:root_001557:B004/m01`); summer browse after spring (`quranic:root_000993:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is a succession of plant forms rather than a generic “nature” motif. Enclosure, upward density, earing grain, low browse, and scent each mark a different stage or mode by which provision occupies the land.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir kişiyle istediği nesne veya eylem arasına girerek onu durdurmayı ve bırakmaya yöneltmeyi açıkça belirtir. Dalın kimliği, vermeme anlamından ve erişilmezlik sağlayan koruyucu güçten bağımsız bir amaç engelleme ilişkisine dayanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel alıkoyma çekirdeğini korurken nesneden uzaklaştıran yapıları, bırakma sebebi soran kalıbı ve engel sonrası geri durma sonucunu ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyle ulaşmak istediği şey veya yapmak istediği eylem arasına girerek onu durdurmak, ondan uzaklaştırmak ya da vazgeçmesine yol açmaktır. Engelleme sonucunda kişi istediği şeyden geri durabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yerin veya kişinin güç, saygınlık ve destekçiler sayesinde erişilemez olmasını; ayrıca koruyup destekleme eylemini aynı koruma ekseninde birleştirir. Dalın çekirdeği sıradan engelleme değil, korunana dışarıdan ulaşılamamasını sağlayan güç ve çevredir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişi ve yer için erişilmezlik bildiren biçimleri, koruyucu güç ve destekçi anlamını ve sabit saygınlık-koruma birlikteliğini ayrı görünümler olarak korur.

facets.statement: Güç, saygınlık veya destekçiler bir kişi ya da yere ulaşılmasını önleyen koruyucu bir durum oluşturur.

Bir topluluğu çevreleyerek korumak, savunmak ve desteklemek aynı koruyucu güç çekirdeğinin eylem görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, güçlü yer ve erişilemeyen kişi örneklerini saygınlık, koruyucu topluluk ve etkin savunma altında birleştirir; ortak sonuç korunana dışarıdan kolayca ulaşılamamasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kanıtta verilen karşılıklı eylem biçimine bağlıdır ve bunu yalın kökün tek taraflı engelleme anlamına yaymaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, genç dişi deve ile dişi oğlağı birlikte adlandırır ve onları zamana ya da çetin yıla karşı kendilerini savunan iki hayvan olarak açıklar. Ancak toplu tanıklık, bu dayanmanın nedenini bir yerde açıkça gençliğe bağlarken başka bir yerde farklı bir neden sözü verir; bu yüzden gençlik açıklaması ortak çekirdeğin zorunlu parçası değil, kaynak değişkeni olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca adı verilen iki genç dişi hayvanın yıl veya zaman karşısındaki dayanma tasviridir; genel gençlik ya da her türlü direnme anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, adı verilen hayvan ikilisine özgü kalıplaşmış kullanımı korur; bunu yalın kökün genel direnme veya gençlik anlamı saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Genç dişi deve ile dişi oğlağı, çetin yılın veya zamanın etkisine karşı kendilerini savunan iki genç hayvan olarak birlikte adlandıran özel bir kullanımdır. Gençlikleri bu dayanmanın bir açıklaması olarak verilir, ancak neden anlatımı kaynaklar arasında tam olarak birleşmez.

facets.statement: Özel adlandırma, genç dişi deve ile dişi oğlağı tek bir hayvan ikilisi olarak gösterir.
İki hayvan, çetin yıla veya zamana karşı kendilerini savunan varlıklar gibi benzetmeli biçimde tasvir edilir.
Dayanmanın gençlikten geldiği açıklaması tanıklıklardan birinde açıkken toplu neden anlatımı tam bir birlik göstermez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı genç dişi hayvan ikilisini zamanla savaşır gibi dayanma tasviri altında birleştirir; dayanmanın gençlikten kaynaklandığı açıklamasının söylenişi ise toplu tanıklıkta değişkenlik gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, herkesin yöneldiği ve arzuladığı genel olumlu değeri kötülüğün karşıtı olarak kurar; ayrıca bağlama göre kötülüğe ya da zarara karşı konabildiğini belirtir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu genel çekirdeği ve yarar yönünü doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel iyilik değeridir; seçme eylemi, özel olarak mal, cömertlik veya belirli bir kullanım kalıbı bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın genel değer anlamıyla sınırlıdır; seçim, mal veya armağanla ilgili özel dalların anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

facets.statement: Herkesçe arzu edilen ve kötülüğün karşısında duran genel olumlu değeri bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanı, hayvanı veya başka bir şeyi iyilik, düzgünlük, güzellik ya da seçkinlik bakımından üstün niteleyen kullanımları birlikte verir. Verilen çerçeve bu niteleme çekirdeğini ve sıradanlıktan uzak seçkinlik sınırını doğru korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya şeyin iyilik, düzgünlük, güzellik ya da başka bir değer yönünden üstün ve seçkin olmasıdır. Çoğul ve seçme bağlamlarında sıradan veya düşük sayılanlardan ayrılmış iyi üyeleri de gösterebilir.

facets.statement: Kişi veya şeyi iyilik ve değer bakımından üstün, iyi ve seçkin olarak niteler.
İnsanlarda düzgünlük ve erdemin yanı sıra güzellik ve hoş görünüş yönünü de belirginleştirebilir.
Bir topluluk veya tür içinden düşük nitelikli olmayan üstün ve seçilmiş üyeleri gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesi, kişi veya şeyde iyilik ve üstünlük bulunmasıdır. Bu üstünlük düzgünlük, güzellik veya seçkinlik olarak belirginleşebilir; çoğul kullanımlar iyi ve düşük nitelikten uzak üyeleri gösterebilir.

Kişi için iki olasılıktan daha iyi olanı Yaratıcıdan dileme ve iyi sonucun belirlenmesini isteme anlamını taşır.
Seçim hakkını bir başkasına bırakma veya birini seçim bakımından üstün gelmiş sayma gibi ilişki biçimlerini kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar daha iyi olanı arayıp seçme çekirdeğinde birleşir. Seçim hakkı ve seçilmiş şey, iyi sonucu Yaratıcıdan dileme, iki şey arasında yetki verme ve seçimde üstün gelme bu çekirdeğin farklı dilsel gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğün mal anlamında kullanılmasını açıkça destekler; ancak kapsam bir anlatımda genel malı gösterirken başka anlatımlarda çokluk ve övülen bir edinme yolu şartıyla daraltılır. Dal korunabilir, fakat bu değişken sınır tanımda açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, sözcüğün malı adlandırmasıdır; çokluk ve övülen yoldan edinilme bazı kullanımların belirgin kısıtıdır, bütün mal kullanımlarına zorunlu şart yapılmaz.

facets.statement: Sözcük, kişinin sahip olduğu malı veya serveti adlandırır.

Miras bırakma ve mala güçlü bağlılık bağlamları bu adlandırmanın örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kullanım malı göstermekle birlikte açıklamaların bir bölümü kapsamı çokluk ve övülen bir edinme yolu şartıyla daraltır. Miras bırakılan veya güçlü biçimde sevilen mal da ortak claim içinde örneklenir.

error_profile.loses: Nicelik vurgusu bulunmayan genel mal ve tekil miras varlığı kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakabilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: mal, özellikle çok veya iyi yoldan edinilmiş servet

error_profile.preserves: Malın değerli veya övülen oluşunu çağrıştırabilir.
error_profile.loses: Ekonomik varlık ve sahip olunan mal çekirdeğini ortadan kaldırır.
error_profile.adds: Soyut ahlaki değer anlamını merkeze taşır.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün genel olumlu değer dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğrudan sahip olunan malı ve serveti adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Mal dışında da arzu edilen her türlü olumlu değeri ve iyiliği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Değerli veya yararlı mal genel iyilik düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirilebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir ekonomik varlık türünü adlandırır; komşu dal ise bu varlığın yalnızca bir örneği olabildiği genel olumlu değerdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin elinde bulunan malı, verilmemiş olsa bile kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Verme niteliğini, armağanı ve kişideki cömertlik bolluğunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Mal, armağan ve cömertlik eyleminin konusu olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal verilen ya da elde tutulan varlıktır; komşu dal o varlığı verme niteliği veya verme sonucudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Malın kendisini ve bazı kullanımlarda onun çokluk niteliğini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Malı tüketme, harcama, ele geçirme veya başkasının malından yararlanma eylemlerini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: mal ile malı tüketme veya alma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın ortak katılımcısı ekonomik varlık olan maldır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir varlık adıdır; komşu dal bu varlık üzerinde gerçekleştirilen tüketme, harcama veya alma eylemidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Genel iyilik, cömertçe verme ve mal üzerinde işlem yapma karşılaştırmaları dal sınırını en açık biçimde gösterdi; çokluk, savurganlık, gecikme veya yön değiştirme gibi daha uzak bağlar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إطلاق الخير على المال، وبخاصة المال الكثير أو المجتمع من وجه محمود، وما يوصى به أو ينفق.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل كل مال مطلقا عند من قيده بالكثرة أو بالوجه المحمود، ولا يدخل الخير الأخلاقي العام إلا بوصفه أصلا أوسع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: إن ترك خيرا أي مالا (sihah;mufradat)؛ لا يقال للمال خير حتى يكون كثيرا ومن مكان طيب (mufradat)؛ وإنه لحب الخير لشديد أي المال الكثير (mufradat)؛ ما كان مجموعا من المال من وجه محمود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi cömertlik niteliğini, armağanı ve vermeyi aynı dalda birleştirir; ayrıca kişide iyiliğin çok oluşunu bu niteliğin göstergesi sayar. Verilen dal çerçevesi, sahip olunan maldan farklı olarak verme ve bolluk yönünü doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal malın kendisini değil, cömertlik niteliğini ve onun armağan ya da verme biçimindeki sonucunu bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın cömertlik ve armağan alanıyla sınırlıdır; yalnızca belirli bir nesneye sahip olma durumu veya genel iyilik bütünü buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Cömert olma niteliği ve bunun armağan ya da verme olarak görünmesidir; kişi için kullanıldığında onda iyiliğin ve verme isteğinin bol bulunduğunu da bildirir.

facets.statement: Kişide bulunan cömertlik ve bolca verme niteliğini bildirir.
Cömertliğin somut sonucu olan armağanı, bağışı veya verme eylemini gösterebilir.
Bir kişide iyiliğin çok olması, onun cömert ve yararlı oluşunun göstergesi olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar cömertlik, armağan ve verme anlamlarını ortak bir alanda toplar. Bir kişide iyiliğin çok olduğunun söylenmesi de cömertlik ve yarar bolluğunun kişiye yüklenen niteliğidir.

concept_gloss.text: cömertlik ve armağan verme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem kişideki verme niteliğini hem de bu niteliğin armağan veya bağış olarak gerçekleşmesini kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Cömertlik niteliğini, verme eylemini ve armağan sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bolca veren ve iyiliği çok olan niteliğinin öne çıktığı bağlamlara uyar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişideki verme isteği ve iyilik bolluğu niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek bir armağanı veya somut verme sonucunu doğrudan adlandırmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Cömertliğin somut olarak verilen bir şey biçiminde gerçekleştiği bağlamlara uyar.

error_profile.preserves: Verme sonucunda alıcıya ulaşan somut yararı korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin sürekli cömertlik niteliğini ve genel iyilik bolluğunu kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Verilebilecek malın bolluğunu dolaylı biçimde çağrıştırır.
error_profile.loses: Cömertlik niteliğini, verme eylemini ve armağan sonucunu kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Elde tutulan ekonomik varlığı anlamın merkezine ekler.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün mal ve servet dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Armağanın kendisini ve kişide genel iyiliğin çok oluşunu da adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: El açıklığını ve arkadaş çevresine bolca verme davranışını daha eylemli biçimde öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da cömertlik, armağan, yararlı davranış ve bolca verme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal nitelik ile armağan sonucunu birlikte kapsar; komşu dal verme davranışının sürekliliğini ve bolluğunu daha belirgin işler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Armağanı ve kişide iyiliğin bol oluşunu bağımsız anlamlar olarak da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Malın yanı sıra bilginin de bolca verilmesini ve bağışta geniş davranmayı açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de eli açıklık ve elindekini başkasına verme niteliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal armağan ve genel iyilik bolluğuna uzanır; komşu dal çeşitli değerleri bolca bağışlama davranışını daha açık sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Cömertliği kişinin niteliği ve armağanı doğrudan adlandıracak biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hak edilmiş bir borç olmadan fazladan iyilikte bulunma ve lütufta bulunma koşulunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Armağan verme ve başkasına yarar sağlama iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel cömertlik ve armağandır; komşu dal verilmesi zorunlu olmayan fazladan iyiliği ve karşılıksız yararı özellikle belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Elindekini verme, armağan etme ve cömert davranma yönünü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Vermeyi engelleme, eli sıkı davranma ve iyiliği esirgeme yönünü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, kişinin elindeki yararı başkasına verip vermemesi ekseninde karşılaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal verme yönündeki olumlu kutuptur; komşu dal aynı eksende vermeme ve engelleme yönündeki karşıt kutuptur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Cömertçe verme, bol bağış, karşılıksız iyilik, esirgeme karşıtlığı ve malın kendisiyle ayrım yayımlandı; yalnızca genel değer, kişisel üstünlük veya uzak bolluk çağrışımı taşıyan adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل المال المملوك بمجرده إلا إذا نظر إليه من جهة العطاء والكرم.
branches.source_phrase_ar: والخير الكرم (maqayis)؛ الخير الهبة (ayn)؛ رجل ذو خير إذا كان كثير الخير (jamhara)؛ الخير بالكسر الكرم (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sırtlan veya çöl sıçanının yuvasındaki bir geçide çubuk ya da engel yerleştirip hayvanı başka bir çıkıştan çıkarmayı açık bir işlem dizisiyle anlatır. Verilen çerçeve hem aracı hem yer değişimini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnızca hayvan, yuva, bir geçidin engellenmesi ve başka çıkıştan çıkma bileşenlerini taşıyan özel kullanıma aittir; iyi olanı seçme anlamına genellenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca sırtlan veya çöl sıçanıyla kurulan özel kullanıma bağlıdır; bu işlem yalın kökün genel anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sırtlanı veya çöl sıçanını yuvasındaki bir geçide çubuk ya da başka bir engel koyarak başka bir çıkıştan dışarı çıkarmaktır. İşlem, bir yolu kapatma ile hayvanın alternatif yola yönelmesi sırasını zorunlu olarak içerir.

facets.statement: Hayvanın yuvasındaki bir geçide engel yerleştirerek onu başka bir çıkışa yöneltme işlemini bildirir.
İşlemin katılımcısı sırtlan veya çöl sıçanı, aracı ise geçidi tıkayan çubuk ya da benzeri bir engeldir.
Bir yuva geçidinin engellenmesi sonucunda hayvanın öteki geçitten çıkması işlemin kurucu sonucudur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, sırtlan veya çöl sıçanının yuvasındaki bir geçidin çubuk ya da engelle kapatılması ve hayvanın bunun sonucunda başka bir çıkıştan dışarı çıkmasıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bir geçidi tıkayıp hayvanı yuvasından çıkarma
concept_gloss.applicability: Sırtlan veya çöl sıçanının yuvasındaki bir yolun engellenip hayvanın başka çıkıştan çıkarıldığı özel işlemi tam olarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Engel yerleştirme, hayvanı yöneltme ve başka çıkıştan çıkarma aşamalarının tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yuvadaki bir geçidin kapatılmasıyla hayvanın alternatif çıkışa yöneltildiği anlatımda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın başka bir çıkışa yöneltilmesi ve dışarı çıkarılması sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Çubuk veya benzeri engelin belirli bir yuva geçidine yerleştirilmesi aşamasını açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sırtlanı, yuvasının bir geçidini tıkayarak başka çıkıştan çıkarma
çöl sıçanını, yuvasının bir geçidini tıkayarak başka çıkıştan çıkarma

error_profile.preserves: Aynı kökteki başka bir kullanımın çağrışımını taşır.
error_profile.loses: Hayvanı, yuvayı, engel koymayı ve başka çıkıştan çıkarmayı bütünüyle kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: İki olasılık arasından iyi olanı isteme düşüncesini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün seçme ve iyi sonucu isteme dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yuvanın bir geçidini engelleyerek hayvanın hareketini ve çıkışını yönlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki ucu bulunan geçidi ve çöl sıçanının kullandığı giriş çıkış yolunu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da çöl sıçanının yer altı yuvası ve alternatif çıkış düzeniyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal geçit üzerinde yapılan bir işlem ve bunun sonucudur; komşu dal işlemin gerçekleştiği geçidin kendisini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir geçidi tıkayarak hayvanı başka çıkıştan bütünüyle dışarı yöneltir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvanın boynunu çamura veya yuva toprağına sokması ya da oradan çıkarması hareketini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hayvanın toprak veya yuva içindeki yönlendirilmiş hareketini konu alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dışarı çıkarma amacı taşıyan insan müdahalesidir; komşu dal hayvanın boynunu sokma veya çıkarma biçimindeki hareketidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli yuva düzeninde bir geçidi kapatıp hayvanı başka çıkıştan çıkarma yöntemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sahipsiz ve yakalanması güç hayvanı arama, yakalama, araç kullanma ve avlanma alanının tamamını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Hayvanı saklandığı yerden çıkarma işlemi daha geniş bir avlanma senaryosunda kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tek ve ayrıntılı bir çıkarma tekniğidir; komşu dal çok sayıda yöntem ve aracı kapsayan genel avlanma etkinliğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yuvaya engel koyup içindeki hayvanı alternatif çıkışa sevk eden eylemi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çöl sıçanının yuvasını veya yuva ağzına yığdığı toprağı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yuva üzerinde işlem ile yuvanın kendisi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da çöl sıçanının yuvasını ve yuva ağzını ortak sahne olarak paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yuvada gerçekleştirilen yönlendirme işlemidir; komşu dal bu işlemin mekânı olan yuva yapısı veya toprağıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar ve aynı kökün diğer dalları değerlendirildi. Çıkış geçidi, yuva içindeki hayvan hareketi, genel avlanma ve yuvanın kendisiyle kurulan sınırlar yayımlandı; tuzak, hayvan adı veya toprağa gizlenme gibi yalnızca sahneyi paylaşan adaylar elendi.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل طلب الخير في الأمرين إلا من جهة اللفظ المشترك والاستخارة العامة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, uygun görülen sınırı ya da hakkı aşmayı açık haksızlıkla birleştirir; haksız saldırı ve baskın da bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal koşmayı, düşman olmayı ya da hastalığın geçmesini değil, hakkın haksız biçimde aşılmasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak sınır aşma çekirdeğini verir; birine saldırma ve baskın yapma anlamlarını yalnızca kendi kullanım kalıplarına bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Uyulması gereken sınırı ya da başkasının hakkını haksız biçimde aşmaktır. Birine saldırmak, malını almak, onu vurmak veya baskın yapmak bu aşmanın özel görünümleri olabilir.

facets.statement: Uyulması gereken sınırı veya başkasının hakkını aşarak açıkça haksızlık etme.
Haksız saldırı, vurma, mal alma ya da baskın yoluyla bu sınır aşımını gerçekleştirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, kişinin durması gereken sınırı geçmesi ve bunu başkasının hakkını çiğneyen açık bir haksızlığa dönüştürmesidir; saldırı ve baskın bu kapsamda yer alır.

concept_gloss.text: hakkı aşan saldırganlık
concept_gloss.applicability: Sınır aşma ile açık haksızlığın birlikte bulunduğu dalın bütün çekirdeği için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hakkı ya da uygun sınırı haksız biçimde aşma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir saldırı türü belirtilmeden genel eylem anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Genel sınır aşma ile haksızlık bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylem bir kişiye saldırma, vurma, mal alma veya baskın yapma biçimindeyse uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Saldırı yoluyla gerçekleşen haksız sınır aşımını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ona saldırıp malını alma ya da onu vurma

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal saldırma ve baskın yapma gibi köke özgü gerçekleşmeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal taşkınlık, başkasına üstünlük taslama ve hak ile gerçek dışı olan arasındaki geçişi daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da hakkın veya kabul edilen sınırın haksız biçimde aşılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekleri büyük ölçüde örtüşür; ancak odak dalın saldırı ve baskın kullanımları ile komşu dalın daha geniş taşkınlık kapsamı bire bir yer değiştirmeyi engeller.
